title: Rule builder-test-edit lets a builder read a test file, or name one in a string
why: A builder may read tests but not edit them; a refused read-only grep costs a round and teaches the reader to scroll past the guard.
note: Filed 09:28 CST Nov 8 (coordinator 09:21 CST, from lane message-time-matches-clock, [ended:lane:-message-time-matches-clock]): the rule refused a builder's read-only grep of hooks/test_guard.py. Red case first: that grep, allowed. Its own lane at round 1; lane builder-probe-false-alarm (#1979) declined it at 09:27 CST. Second red case 09:53 CST Nov 8 (lane notes-fix-large-1, [ended:lane:-notes-fix-large-1]): a fed-write-r3 builder was refused on a Python string that only held a test path. Doing 05:58 CST Nov 10: open PR #2124 on branch builder-read-grep-refused (triage live build). Back to ready 07:22 CST Nov 12 (coordinator yes 07:21 CST): no live lane.
